articles.title: UAE condemns Iran's 'brazen' attack on tankers as US launches fresh strikes
articles.description: The third consecutive night of US strikes on Iran came as Trump announced a 20% charge as part of a new blockade on the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Lindsey Graham's sister chosen as replacement after senator's death
articles.description: The South Carolina governor chose the senator's little sister to serve out the rest of his term after Graham's death on Saturday.

articles.title: Sudan's paramilitary RSF chief sentenced to death over war crimes
articles.description: Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo was convicted in absentia along with 15 RSF commanders and allies.

articles.title: US senators demand findings of probe into deadly strike on Iran school
articles.description: Senators have demanded the US military urgently reveals the findings of its probe into a deadly missile strike on an Iranian school.

articles.title: Alleged hackers linked to Russia facing UK and EU sanctions
articles.description: Alleged hackers linked to Russia have been jointly sanctioned by the UK and EU.
